name: SMEEF competitive grant rounds
summary: Flexible Scottish fund for marine and coastal restoration projects, from planting and propagation to survey and community engagement, run as competitive rounds with criteria set for each round.

geography.label: UK-based applicants; projects delivered in Scotland

applicant_types.quote: SMEEF funds constituted groups and organisations. For-profit organisations are welcome to apply to SMEEF, but they should form part of a consortium application with a non-profit or community group.

geography.quote: The applicant(s) must be based in the UK and all projects must be delivered in Scotland.

access.quote: At the moment we run competitive grant rounds and make targeted interventions as funds allow.
